digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud adapter / rebar reconciler backend
propositions: Exact-value characterization tests must pin the current output of all Jira adapter units before shared units are moved during DC work extraction, preventing silent mapping regressions during refactoring
The existing contract suite is backend-agnostic by design and cannot detect Jira-specific mapping regressions, so a separate characterization oracle is required
All value maps must be asserted for both every known key and unmapped keys hitting documented defaults, since defaults are the branches most likely to be dropped during extraction
Sanitizers and identity conversion functions must have assertions at, below, and above their documented limits to preserve off-by-one behaviors and rejection conditions
For each of three pinned units, mutating a source value must cause the corresponding characterization test to fail, proving the oracle actively gates against regression
